title: Scam
body:
I would give it zero if I could. I was still testing it out and u can't get past some features without signing up for trial then it charged me subscription even if it was supposedly a trial. 

Since I was charged anyway, I decided to give it a spin to use and it's basically a list that Evernote or any note app provides.

Habit RPG is way more useful in habit building and to-do lists and I never had to be blindsided to pay for it!

title: Takes your money!!! A MONEY SCAM!! TAKE THIS OFF APPSTORE!!!
body:
If I can rate 0 stars it would that. 

I subscribed to the FREE one week subscription. When the FREE subscription ended I was FORCED to pay for a re-subscription. There was no option to cancel, and I cannot download any apps because my payment method got declined (I did not put anything on it because THIS app will deduct another week worth of subscription) I tried changing my payment method BUT apple said HABITBOX needs at least one payment in their system. So I paid this USELESS app anyway just so I can cancel it. 

Upon payment, the “Cancel Subscription” is now present and when I pressed it this app is still on my active subscriptions and I bet it’ll force me to buy another subscription after the 1 week premium access I bought. 

THIS IS A SCAM!!! AS FOR THE APP ITSELF, IT’S PRETTY FREAKING USELESS! USING MY IPHONE’S ALARM IS BETTER AT REMINDING ME OF THE TASKS AND REMINDERS THAT I NEEDED.

AGAIN DO NOT DOWNLOAD!!
